bio_en: Gegham Tadevosian was born in 1884 in the Nork quarter of Yerevan to modest parents surrounded by revolutionary relatives, and completed the diocesan school in 1908 after interruptions. Committed to the ARF from school, he went as a teacher to Vaspurakan and Persia in 1911, continuing party work with Toros Aloyan during the Persian reaction. In 1918, with a group of fighters and Assyrians, he broke through the Turkish-Kurdish lines and crossed southern Persia from Salmast and Urmia to Soujbulagh, Miandoab and beyond. He died in 1919 and was buried in Yerevan.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Obituary in Haraj (Yerevan), 27 Sept 1919.
